{{Quote|Dangerous desert; home to many fiends and treasures.|Description}}
'''Eluut Sands''' {{J|イルート砂漠|Irūto sabaku}} is a desert location in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''. It can be placed after the completion of "Mission #003: The Cheetahs" and is the site of "Mission #004: Desert Peril". When [[Marche Radiuju|Marche]] learns of rabid monsters inhabiting the desert, he comes to investigate.

After the monsters are defeated, [[Montblanc]] explains to Marche that the monsters' behavior may be a result of the magical [[Crystal (term)|Crystals]], which [[Bervenia Palace]] created. Eluut Sands is also the site of "Mission #036: Twin Swords", "Mission #037: Village Hunt", "Mission #092: Cursed Bride", and "Mission #106: Resistance". It can be freed in "Mission #243: Eluut Sands", after "Mission #007: Diamond Rain" is completed.
